refusal.record: int32 slots, one per exact validity predicate; zero before each entry; any nonzero refuses; host constructs AdFailureRecord

codes.1: validity predicate is false; see the slot source_id

preconditions: All dimensions positive, nlev >= 2 for w lap4, products fit signed int32.

Primal buffers are disjoint from all derivative, failure, and workspace buffers. Distinct incoming and outgoing cotangent buffers are disjoint; tangent in-place aliasing is allowed only where launch_abi explicitly says inout.
Mesh indices in range; cell/vertex inverse incidence is exactly consistent with cells_on_edge/vertices_on_edge; no duplicate incidence; n_edges_on_cell <= max_edges.
Damping has 0 <= n_cells_solve <= ncells. Geometry distances and areas must be finite and nonzero; all live differentiable values and intermediates must be finite.
A failed slot refuses the entire gradient; do not publish partial writes.

accumulation: One deterministic owner gathers each cell, edge, and vertex cotangent in incidence order; contributions use f64 registers and round once to f32 at the output. Scalar parameters use a fixed 256-lane f64 tree. No floating-point atomics.
math: MPAS FP32 helper arithmetic; fmad=false, ftz=true; Euclidean cotangents.
